THE KING OF POP

Michael Jackson

Michael Jackson was one of the most influential entertainers in music history. His music, dancing, performances and visual storytelling helped redefine what a pop performance could be.

From unforgettable live moments to groundbreaking music videos, his work continues to inspire performers and fans around the world. MJ Network exists to celebrate that legacy through creative Roblox recreations.

MJ NETWORK [MJN]

About Us

Welcome to MJ Network — a fan-made Roblox project dedicated to recreating legendary Michael Jackson moments and performances.

Founded by @Looky in March 2026, MJN brings together creativity, Roblox production, stage design and a love for Michael Jackson's work.

Our goal is simple: revive the moments, recreate the performances, and keep the legacy moving.
